steps.title: Get 70 smithing
steps.note: Smelt gold bars at the Blast Furnace with goldsmith gauntlets (fastest viable); Giants' Foundry is a good XP + profit alternative.

steps.title: Get 68 mining
steps.note: 3-tick mine granite (3t4g) at Bandit Camp Quarry / Cape Conch for fastest XP; no-tick: iron to 70 then Volcanic Mine. AFK: Motherlode Mine.

steps.title: Get 62 Crafting
steps.note: Cut gems for fastest XP: sapphire -> emerald -> ruby -> diamond; keep cutting diamonds to 62.

steps.title: Get 60 agility
steps.note: Wilderness Agility Course - fastest here (deep Wilderness, keep risk low and watch for PKers).

steps.title: Get 50 construction
steps.note: Build oak larders in the POH Kitchen (8 oak planks each) - cheap and fast; switch to oak dungeon doors at 74 to stay cheap.

steps.title: Get 70 ranged (DHCB?)
steps.note: Chin (throw chinchompas at) maniacal monkeys in Kruk's Dungeon, Ape Atoll (needs Monkey Madness II ch.II) - fastest Ranged XP.
